items.statement: IR-66-SEM-01 — Shared template mislabels a LiDAR band (documented bug, not propagated here). 60GEMSDOE/src/gems32/h33.py lidar_scarp_composite() documents '0.45*ex_max + 0.35*step_max + 0.20*downface_max' but reads raster bands 1, 2 and 5. Against the pinned sidecar band order [ex_max, ex_mean, step_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max, relief, coh100, strike, valid], band 2 is ex_mean (not step_max, which is band 3) and band 5 is lappos_max (not downface_max, which is band 6). So two of the three terms are not the documented ones, and they are also the wrong kind of quantity: the code averages a mean-slope and a Laplacian convexity where the prose claims a slope-break amplitude and a down-face gradient. Verified by reading both files in this sandbox (lines 149-156 and the sidecar band list). This repo does not reuse that composite; the fix belongs in the template (one edit, one PR) and is reported here rather than silently forked. Any H32/H33/H68-descended 'scarp' weight in a shipped raster inherits this.
items.status: UPSTREAM-FIX-CANDIDATE
